How to create a website for free
Follow these 6 simple steps to create a website today.
Get Started
Learn more
Define your website goals
Identify your needs and map out your audience. Whether you're launching an eCommerce store or starting a blog , your goals shape your site structure, pages, and the message
Choose a free website builder
Find an all-in-one web creation platform that combines AI tools, templates , design features and free hosting so you can create, manage and launch your site faster—no technical skills required.
Pick a domain name
Choose a domain name that reflects your brand and is easy for people to remember. You can start with a free Wix domain and upgrade to a custom one when you’re ready to take the next step.
Create and customize
Start with a prompt or a template on an AI website builder , then customize using drag and drop or vibe-coding. Adjust layouts, colors, fonts, images and content to match your brand.
Optimize for SEO and mobile
Make your site mobile-friendly and easy to find. Good SEO starts with page titles, meta descriptions and alt text — structured so both visitors and search engines understand your site.
Publish and grow your website
Once your site looks good, publish it and go live. Then use built-in marketing tools, integrations and analytics to drive traffic, engage visitors and grow your online presence.

Website builder FAQs
What is a website builder?
Show more
A website builder is a platform that allows anyone to create a website without any coding knowledge. The best website builders offer drag and drop editing, AI-powered tools and customizable website templates , handling everything you need from design to hosting and even securing a domain. Wix offers an intuitive website builder that combines vibe coding with freeform drag and drop, and ready-to-use business solutions.
Is it easy to build a website?
Show more
Yes—you don’t need to know how to code. Wix is an intuitive no-code website builder with a few ways to create your own website, so you can choose the process that works best for you. Pick from 2000+ designer-made templates, use the AI website builder to create a business-ready site through a conversational interface, or start from scratch with Wix’s drag and drop website builder . Whichever way you choose, you can keep customizing in the Editor for total website design freedom—and add advanced functionality with code whenever you want.
How do I choose the best website builder?
Show more
The best website builder is one that supports your specific needs and business goals. Key factors to consider: Ease of use—an intuitive drag and drop editor with AI tools. Website templates—a large selection tailored to your industry. AI tools—that help with content, images and business insights, not just design. Business software —built-in solutions like eCommerce, scheduling and marketing tools. Apps and integrations—hundreds of Wix-made and 3rd party apps are available through the Wix App Market , including Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel and Zapier. Security and support—reliable hosting, data encryption and 24/7 customer care. A website builder will also cost you significantly less than hiring a developer—but if you want expert help, you can hire a freelance web developer through the Wix Marketplace at a cost that suits your budget.
What types of websites can you build on Wix?
Show more
With Wix’s free website creator, you can create any kind of website you want, including: Business sites —build and grow your professional presence online, whatever your industry. Online stores —sell products, offer subscriptions and run marketing campaigns with an all-in-one eCommerce solution. Blogs —share what’s on your mind with an easy-to-manage blog. Portfolios —showcase your work with beautiful visuals and custom layouts. Restaurants —take reservations, display your menu and run your ordering system from one place. Enterprise corporations —multi-site management and everything a big business needs.
How much does it cost to build a website?
Show more
With Wix, you can build your website and publish it completely free—design your site, publish it and share it with the world without spending a dime. To connect a custom domain, remove ads and unlock advanced business features like selling through an online store, you’ll need to upgrade to one of Wix’s Premium plans . Overall cost varies depending on the features you need—and can be significantly higher if you pay a developer instead of using an all-inclusive platform like Wix.
Does my free website come with hosting?
Show more
Yes. When you create a website with Wix, you get reliable, scalable multi-cloud web hosting that ensures 99.99% uptime, plus automatic disaster recovery and worldwide CDN coverage. Your site also comes with 2 layers of DDoS protection, 24/7 security monitoring and HTTPS and SSL protection, so your website is always safe and secure.
How can I connect a domain to my website?
Show more
Every free Wix site comes with a built-in Wixsite domain (i.e., mysite.wixsite.com ). To look more professional and boost your credibility, you can get a new custom domain name for a year with the initial purchase of an annual Premium plan—through Wix's domain registration , choosing from over 400 domain extensions like .com, .net and .org. If you already own a domain name, you can connect or transfer it to your Wix site.
How can I optimize my site for SEO on Wix?
Show more
All Wix sites are designed with SEO best practices in mind and come with a suite of built-in SEO tools and guidance. Customize your SEO settings, use AI to generate meta tags and descriptions, and get instant homepage indexing. Your site also comes with an SEO assistant that analyzes your pages and recommends ways to improve search performance, plus key integrations like Google Search Console and Semrush. Check out this Google case study for more on Wix SEO.

FAQ
What is Premium plan?
Show more
Creating your own website is free. With a Premium plan you can connect your own domain, remove Wix branding from your site, and more. Most Premium plans include a 1 year free domain voucher, which is only valid with a purchase of a new domain from Wix and cannot be used to renew or extend a domain you already own. For best value, we recommend our yearly or multi-year plans.
Can I try a Wix Premium plan for free?
Show more
Yes. Try any Wix Premium plan and if you decide it's not for you, you can cancel within 14 days and receive a full refund—no questions asked. This applies to the initial upgrade to a Premium plan.
How do I get my free domain?
Show more
Most yearly or multi-year Premium plans come with a 1 year free domain voucher. You can choose your own domain name with suffixes such as .com, .net, .org and more. Once you find the perfect domain for your site, your voucher will be waiting for you at checkout. This voucher is only included with the first time purchase of a Premium plan. It is not included when renewing a plan or upgrading an existing plan. The voucher is redeemable within 60 days following your purchase, and is only valid towards the purchase of a new domain from Wix. The free domain voucher cannot be used to renew an existing domain.
Why do I need a custom domain?
Show more
A custom domain, like mystunningwebsite.com, is a great way to get found online and promote your brand. Replace your free Wix URL (username.wixsite.com/sitename) with a custom domain you purchased from Wix, or one you already own.
How can I get my own personalized email address?
Show more
Once you have your own domain, you can purchase a Google Workspace plan and get a custom email address using your domain, like info@mystunningwebsite.com . We've partnered with Google to give you 30GB of Drive storage, as well as Google Calendar, Docs, Sheets and Slides.
Where can I find my billing information?
Show more
Sign into your Wix account and choose Billing & Payments from the main menu at the top-right of the page. You'll see all your subscriptions and billing history right there.
What online payments are accepted?
Show more
Wix accepts all major credit cards and debit cards, including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, JCB and Diners. Additional payment options may be available in your specific location.
How do I know if the Enterprise plan is right for my business?
Show more
